papers.title: Effect of heat treatment on corrosion behaviour of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V alloy in Ringer's solution
papers.abstract: The additive manufacturing is developing rapidly among the advanced technologies to fabricate the orthopaedic and dental implants with complex shape (e.g. spherical) due to such advantages as high production efficiency and minimal waste of material. Ti-6Al-4V alloy samples were fabricated by the technology of selective laser melting. The effect of a post heat treatment, carried out below the polymorphic transformation temperature, on the microstructure and corrosion behaviour of the alloy was investigated. It was determined that such a heat treatment of the microstructure leads to improving corrosion resistance of Ti-6Al-4V alloy in Ringer's solution due to a growth of the β phase, an decrease of the α' martensite and microstrain in the α/α' lattice. • Ti-6Al-4V alloy samples were manufactured by selective laser melting technology. • Heat treatment led to improving corrosion resistance of alloy in Ringer's solution. • This is associated with growth of β phase and decrease of α' martensite.

summary_en.motivation: To improve the corrosion resistance of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V alloy in simulated body fluid.
summary_en.method: Heat treatment below the polymorphic transformation temperature was applied and its effect on microstructure and corrosion behavior was investigated.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment enhanced corrosion resistance due to increased β phase and decreased α' martensite and microstrain.
summary_en.validation: Electrochemical corrosion tests were performed in Ringer's solution.

papers.title: Review on the application of ultrasonic vibration-assisted turning in enhancing machinability of Ti-6Al-4V alloy
papers.abstract: Ti-6Al-4V alloy is an α+β titanium alloy that is widely used in aerospace, marine, automobile, architectural, power/energy sectors, and various medical equipment industries due to its exceptional properties, including low density, high fracture toughness, excellent creep and corrosion resistance, a high strength-to-weight ratio, and superior biocompatibility. However, due to some other properties, such as poor thermal conductivity, high heat stress, low elastic modulus, high chemical reactivity, and significant work hardening, it is classified as a difficult-to-cut material. These kinds of materials face difficulties in cutting, such as heat concentration in the cutting zone, high cutting forces, and tool wear acceleration, which results in poor surface finish quality. Therefore, an ultrasonic vibration-assisted turning (UVAT) method has been proposed, which proved to be an efficient method to overcome these difficulties during Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy cutting. This review article presents the application of the Ti-6Al-4V alloy, the principle of UVAT, and the impact of UVAT on various factors, including chip formation, tool wear, cutting forces, cutting temperature, surface morphology, and roughness. In addition, the significance of minimum quantity lubrication (MQL) in UVAT of Ti-6Al-4V alloy and the finite element analysis (FEA) of UVAT of Ti-6Al-4V alloy are summarized. Expected outcomes include a deeper understanding of the improvements in surface quality, reduction in cutting forces, and enhanced tool life through the UVAT process. The findings aim to guide future research and provide practical insights for manufacturers looking to optimize machining of Ti-6Al-4V alloys for better performance and sustainability in manufacturing processes.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了超声振动辅助车削对Ti-6Al-4V合金切削性能的影响，但未涉及增材制造后处理或力学性能，与用户关注方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: Paper does not address additive manufacturing; it focuses on conventional Ti-6Al-4V machinability, not post-processing of AM parts to improve mechanical performance (fatigue, tensile).

summary_zh.motivation: 综述超声振动辅助车削在提高Ti-6Al-4V合金切削性能中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾了UVAT对切屑形成、刀具磨损、切削力、温度及表面形貌的影响。
summary_zh.result: UVAT能显著改善表面质量、降低切削力并延长刀具寿命。
summary_zh.validation: 本文为文献综述，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To review the application of ultrasonic vibration-assisted turning (UVAT) in enhancing the machinability of Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
summary_en.method: The paper systematically summarizes the effects of UVAT on chip formation, tool wear, cutting forces, temperature, and surface morphology.
summary_en.result: UVAT significantly improves surface quality and reduces cutting forces, enhancing tool life.
summary_en.validation: This is a review article with no experimental validation; it synthesizes existing literature.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the corrosion behavior of TC4 coatings on 316L SS in supercritical water environments.
summary_en.method: TC4 coatings were fabricated by cold spraying followed by laser remelting, then exposed to oxygenated NaCl-containing super/subcritical water.
summary_en.result: Microstructural evolution and corrosion mechanisms were characterized, revealing the influence of laser remelting on corrosion resistance.
summary_en.validation: Experimental corrosion tests and microstructural analysis.
